title: Dispatch a ready fork and join after integration

rubric.text: Dispatches API and DOC concurrently only because both are ready, independent, and have isolated worktrees
Waits to dispatch WIRE until both prerequisite commits are accepted before integration, integrated, and their affected checks pass at that head
Checks conflicts and reruns affected validation at the integrated head before releasing WIRE, without a second discretionary lead acceptance after ordinary merges
